PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 28, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email comments to commission@lbutilities.org

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-55205  Recommendation to approve May 14, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55206  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for May 28, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55207  Recommendation to authorize approval of the option to extend each of the
  following agreements for one additional one-year period: Agreement Nos. UT-3887
  (DRP Engineering, Inc.); UT-3888 (JIG Consultants); UT-3889 (Anser Advisory,
  LLC); UT-3890 (Lee & Ro, Inc.); and UT-3891 (Willdan Engineering), for providing
  on-call construction management; and authorize the General Manager to execute
  all documents necessary to amend the agreements accordingly.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55208  Recommendation to authorize approval of the option to extend each of the
  following agreements for one additional one-year period: Agreement Nos. UT-3881
  (Twining, Inc.); UT-3882 (Kleinfelder, Inc.); and UT-3883 (Ninyo & Moore), for
  providing on-call geotechnical engineering support services; and authorize the
  General Manager to execute all documents necessary to amend the agreements
  accordingly.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 5
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 28, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

5.  26-55209  Recommendation to authorize approval of the option to extend each of the
  following agreements for one additional one-year period: Agreement Nos. UT-3884
  (Coast Surveying, Inc.); UT-3885 (Psomas); and UT-3886 (Johnson-Frank &
  Associates, Inc.), for on-call survey engineering support services; and authorize
  the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to amend the
  agreements accordingly.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55211  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement Nos. UT-3907 (Order of Grace Compliance LLC)
  and UT-3908 (Cumming Management Group, Inc.), for on-call Project Labor
  Agreement administration and compliance monitoring services, to increase
  contract amount by $300,000 for a revised contract amount not to exceed
  $1,800,000, and extend each agreement for an additional one-year period.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55212  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-26-321 and award a contract to
  Haaker Equipment Company to furnish and deliver hydraulic cleaning tools,
  miscellaneous equipment, and repair services in an annual amount not to exceed
  $100,000 for a period of one year, with the option to renew for two additional one-
  year periods, subject to a maximum annual increase of 10% for each renewal
  period, for a total contract amount not to exceed $331,000, and authorize the
  General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract,
  including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

8.  26-55213  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Public Utilities
  Department Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Planning Session 2 Presentation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-55214  Recommendation to receive and file Campus Realignment and Modernization
  Update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 26-55215  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-01-25 and award a contract to
  Advanced Industrial Services, Inc., for the Alamitos Tanks No. 11 & 13
  Rehabilitation Project (EO-3600), in a total amount not to exceed $5,328,950; and

  Page 2 of 5
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 28, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into
  the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 26-55216  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal to provide Construction
  Management and Inspection Services for the Alamitos Tanks No. 11 & 13
  Rehabilitation Project (EO-3600), and award a contract to Accenture Infrastructure
  and Capital Projects, LLC, in a total amount not to exceed $785,051, for a period of
  three years; and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to enter into the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 26-55217  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement No. 35894 with ARB, Inc., to increase the contract
  amount by $8,000,000, and extend the term of the contract an additional six
  months.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

13. 26-55218  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to enter into one or more
  Natural Gas Commodity Fixed Price Swap Agreements pursuant to the
  International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Master Agreements to
  provide natural gas price protection with terms that meet or exceed the following
  conditions: (1) a term of no more than three years; and (2) pricing indexed to the
  Southern California Border.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

14. 26-55219  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal No. UD-26-315 for consulting
  services and award a contract to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP to provide
  strategic planning services in a total amount not to exceed $437,325, plus a
  contingency of $43,735, for a total contract amount not to exceed $481,060 for a
  period of one year, with an option to renew for two additional six month periods;
  and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter
  into the contract, including any subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

15. 26-55220  Recommendation to establish an ad hoc committee consisting of one member for
  the limited purpose of addressing matters related to the Strategic Plan, with such
  committee terminating upon completion of the Strategic Plan effort; and have the
  President of the Board appoint the member.

  Page 3 of 5
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 28, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

16. 26-55221  Recommendation to receive and file May 14, 2026 Resources Committee Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
